hint: ผมมั่นใจว่า EKG นี้เป็น STEMI เฉียบพลัน

parsed.rationale: Sinus rhythm with ST elevation in II, III and aVF (III the largest) and reciprocal ST depression with T inversion in aVL, which fits acute inferior STEMI; the mild ST elevation in the lateral chest leads is probably a minor accompanying finding.
